title: Specific carbohydrate diet versus Mediterranean diet in adult patients with mild to moderate ulcerative colitis: a randomized controlled-feeding trial
comparison_or_design: The primary controlled-feeding comparison of Specific Carbohydrate Diet and Mediterranean diet.
observations_or_assays: Clinical remission under the reported pMCS criterion
Fecal calprotectin normalization under the reported criterion
time_scope: Baseline to week 6, primary ITT/BOCF analysis.
excluded: Week-10, complete-case/sensitivity analyses and other inflammatory thresholds
Quality of life, microbiome and metagenomic outcomes
population_or_material: The primary ITT population of adults with mild-to-moderate UC in the controlled-feeding pilot trial.
requested_items: Arm-level raw and ANCOVA-adjusted week-six pMCS summaries/changes and primary contrast; week-six remission and FC normalization count/proportion/test in their applicable populations. Exclude combined-cohort summaries, baseline-normalization results, later visits and unrelated biomarkers.
